method: Each rectangle is [u0,v0,u1,v1] in its own 887px square panel, from top-left. Percentiles are relative display luminance after inverse sRGB and Rec.709 weighting, not scene radiance or material albedo.
comparison: Choose corresponding visible surface regions by material and orientation in the engine shots. The concept is not a geometrically calibrated render. Compare the ordering, spread and local contrast first at fixed exposure, then check the highlight changes under a small viewpoint change.
